faqs.q: How do you choose the best digital marketing agency for dietary products in India?
faqs.a: Look for experience with health advertising rules, marketplace growth and repeat-purchase tracking. The best digital marketing service for dietary products in India checks every claim before publishing and reports cost per order, not just traffic or followers.

faqs.q: What health claims can supplement brands make in India?
faqs.a: Claims must be truthful, specific and backed by evidence. Food safety rules don't allow supplements to claim they prevent, treat or cure diseases. Describe ingredients and general wellbeing benefits carefully, and have claims reviewed before publishing.

faqs.q: Can supplement brands run Google and Meta ads?
faqs.a: Yes, within platform policies. Ads can't make unproven health claims or promote restricted ingredients, and some products need extra review. Campaigns perform best when ad copy, landing pages and product claims are checked together before launch.

faqs.q: Should supplement brands sell on marketplaces or their own website?
faqs.a: Both, for different jobs. Marketplaces bring ready buyers and volume. Your own website builds direct relationships, customer data and repeat orders. Most brands use marketplaces for reach and their website for loyalty and margin.

faqs.q: Can supplement brands work with health influencers?
faqs.a: Yes, carefully. Influencers giving health information should have relevant qualifications, and every paid post must be clearly disclosed. Product experience content is safer than health advice, and claims should match what the brand is legally allowed to say.

faqs.q: How much should a supplement brand spend on digital marketing?
faqs.a: Work backwards from cost per order and repeat rate, not a fixed budget. Spend more where customers reorder, because a buyer who orders three times justifies a higher first-order cost. Review channel performance monthly and adjust.
